integrity: The all-field theorem rests on explicit elementwise interpolation equations and their solution in each characteristic. Finite checks support but do not replace the proof.
scientific_limitations: Only linear local automorphisms of the three-dimensional nonunital null-filiform associative algebra are classified; larger algebras, nonlinear local maps and 2-local automorphisms are not considered. Publication priority remains provisional.
title: Field-dependent local automorphisms of the three-dimensional null-filiform associative algebra
